name: What is the average cost to finish a basement?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost to finish a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to finish a basement varies widely based on size, desired finishes, and functionality. Basic finishing, including framing, insulation, drywall, and basic flooring, might range from $40 to $75 per square foot. Adding a bathroom, kitchenette, or custom features significantly increases the cost, potentially reaching $100-$150+ per square foot. Factors such as electrical upgrades, plumbing extensions, and the quality of materials selected also influence the overall budget. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement finishing costs typically range from $40 to $150+ per square foot, depending on project scope, finishes, and added features like bathrooms or kitchenettes.
